base_candidate.role: frozen Nautilus execution, costs, account, external pools and current-NAV risk path

prior_failure.diagnosis: Residual ownership reversed V5's negative growth and produced activity in all six exposed intervals, but only E01 was uniformly profitable. The state could refresh accepted ownership while retaining the original activation timestamp, allowing a five-minute leg which began before the refresh to consume new evidence. The residual continuation engine also normalized the current displacement with an ATR that already contained that displacement, unlike the sender detector. Path diagnostics showed convergence parity is an intermediate transfer state rather than a profitable final target.

exposed_diagnostics.source: V6 causal event, plan, order, position and one-minute path attribution on E01-E06
exposed_diagnostics.limitations: All diagnostics are exposed, post-hoc mechanism development. The four matching winners are not independent success evidence and the numeric boundaries cannot support a performance claim.

research_question: After exactly three sender markets convert common flow into price progress, can the sole residual receiver be traded only when a completely post-evidence five-minute leg demonstrates substantial but incomplete delivery, with convergence still unconsumed and close enough to prove catch-up without serving as the final target?

hypothesis.sender_state: Two distinct completed five-minute common-flow events must share exactly three accepted sender markets, produce positive median signed progress, majority advance, and majority first-origin hold. Sender impulses use only prior completed five-minute ATR.
hypothesis.effective_evidence_boundary: Every activation or accepted refresh creates a new effective evidence timestamp. A residual leg whose completed five-minute bar began at or before that timestamp is no-trade, even when the portfolio state identifier is retained.
hypothesis.information_ownership: The three accepted sender markets supplied the state evidence and remain terminal no-trade. A four-market response has no residual receiver. The sole excluded market is the only possible receiver.
hypothesis.residual_lag: At confirmation the residual market's signed log progress from the first event must be strictly less than the accepted sender median, leaving a positive delivery gap.
hypothesis.fresh_leg: The residual must independently complete a new post-evidence five-minute MSS, same-direction displacement, strict three-candle FVG and passive first consequent-encroachment retracement. Its displacement is normalized with prior completed five-minute ranges only.
hypothesis.bounded_transfer: The residual displacement must be at least one half but strictly less than the weakest accepted sender displacement. This defines a receiver that has begun material delivery but has not become an equal-or-stronger information owner.
hypothesis.convergence_state: Cross-market parity is an intermediate state, not take profit. It must remain unconsumed before the plan and lie strictly ahead by less than one costed planned-loss unit. A non-positive gap means delivery is already complete; a gap of one risk unit or more means the fresh leg has not yet demonstrated sufficiently mature transfer.
hypothesis.invalidation_and_target: The stop remains beyond the residual leg's protected swing or opposing bar and the final target remains the next causally live completed-4H or previous-day external liquidity pool. Entry, invalidation and target belong to the receiver's new leg; parity only validates the transfer stage.
hypothesis.family_isolation: V1-V3 SCDAM, SESSION_I7, accepted-market continuation, unbounded V6 residual continuation, and malformed receiver states remain terminally rejected.
hypothesis.execution_safety: A post-only parent rejection while flat is expected passive non-execution. Any protective rejection after fill is an implementation/evidence failure and immediately fail-closes exposure.

router.progress_rule: positive median signed log return and majority advance
router.origin_rule: majority remains beyond the first confirming origins
router.tradable_market_policy: sole market excluded from current accepted_symbols

selection.method: E01-E06 are the same fully exposed mechanism-development intervals used by V4-V6. Reuse isolates causal timing, unit consistency and transfer-state changes; it can never support a success claim.

claim_rules: E01-E06 are exposed development periods and can only reject or improve the bounded-transfer mechanism.
V6 path diagnostics and the four matching winners are post-hoc exposed evidence, not success evidence.
The 0.5-to-1 sender-relative body interval and 0-to-1 parity-risk interval define an incomplete-but-material transfer state; they are not an optimized success threshold claim.
The external target, protected same-leg invalidation, costs, 3% current-NAV risk sizing and one-global-slot rule remain unchanged.
Passing development permits a source freeze and newly predeclared confirmation; it is not success.

Success requires a frozen continuous-account evaluation with realistic costs, sufficient independent opportunities, no liquidation, no unrecoverable account damage, and project-level daily geometric growth of at least 1%.
